audit.why: 50.29% over 509 games and 6/10 difficulty match the shape: Kled owns level 1, levels 2-6 are skill, Gangplank owns first item, Kled owns 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts disagreed with the packet chart AND with the page's own whys at five of seven stages: they gave Level 1 to Gangplank (whys[0] says Kled is a level-1 skirmish bully), gave Levels 3 and 4-5 to Kled (whys[2] and whys[3] both say even), gave Level 6 to Gangplank (whys[4] says roughly even), and gave First item to Kled (whys[5] says Gangplank out-bursts him).
audit.why: Every one of those rows argued with the paragraph printed beside it.
audit.corrected: win[0], win[2], win[3], win[4], win[5] and the matching phases[N].side/.rating/.why brought onto the packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) The full layer calls his Q 'Beartrap on a Rope' throughout; the real name is Bear Trap on a Rope (two words). (2) tldr, report[0] and dosFull[1].t say to 'Q-cleanse his pull' — Gangplank cleanses with Remove Scurvy (W), not Parrrley.
audit.why: A player reading 'Q-cleanse' will hold the wrong button against an 11-second yank that decides the lane. Bear Trap is 800 range on 11/10/9/8/7s, and Jousting is a 550 dash he can re-cast to return — neither number appeared anywhere.
audit.corrected: Name fixed across the full layer; cleanse attributed to Remove Scurvy; real cooldowns and ranges added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], winCon and dosFull[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] and breakdown.late prescribe early anti-heal 'because his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.why: Kled has no healing ability in his kit — Skaarl's courage is a remount mechanic, not a heal, and whether Grievous Wounds touches it is not something the kit text answers. Meanwhile his Bear Trap, Jousting and autos are all physical, which is the real itemisation cue and matches the Plated Steelcaps already listed.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line replaced with the physical-damage rationale in report[8] and breakdown.late.
sources: enemyKit — no heal flag on any slot

audit.whatIsWrong: Violent Tendencies is an attack-speed burst whose wind-up, not its cast, is the tell.
audit.why: There is no cast animation to react to — the four fast attacks are the warning.
audit.corrected: Added to tradeGood, breakdown.trading, report[3] and dontsFull[2].
